natural_body: Price-sensitive SMB 40% off: signups +31%, rev +18%, retention -12%.

first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, while prior evidence indicates that simplifying and shortening onboarding produced durable activation, completion, and time-to-value gains. This is better aligned with sustainable qualified revenue than promotional pricing, which previously reduced retention despite increasing signups and revenue. Verify the two directly relevant onboarding records before committing.
